A pragmatic Talent Acquisition Specialist skilled in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition and HRIS processes, with experience supporting high-volume hiring and stakeholder management.

Dec 2024 - Present

Led targeted sourcing campaigns and used Git-based tracking for candidate outreach templates and version control of hiring playbooks. Regularly analyzed hiring metrics to accelerate time-to-fill for critical roles.

Recruiter, Tata Consultancy Services
Apr 2021 - Nov 2024
Executed high-volume Talent Acquisition mandates across technology and consulting portfolios, handling full-cycle Recruitment from sourcing to onboarding. Maintained and optimized HRIS candidate data to ensure accurate reporting and reduced mismatches between requisitions and candidate profiles. Built reusable Git repositories for interview assessment templates and candidate communication assets to standardize processes across regional teams. Collaborated with business leaders to meet quarterly hiring goals and improve offer acceptance rates.

Skills: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HRIS, Git
